pages.title: Beyond the Fence
pages.text: Pay for one actual expansion of your town.

pages.title: Beyond the Fence
pages.text: Fences, paving and lights help develop the purchased extension.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Use native map/town expansion mode, review the boundary and price, then confirm. Server validates overlap, ownership, minimum quote and funds. Personal waypoints stay private.

pages.title: Useful to know
pages.text: Expansion is priced, server-validated territory rather than drawing a personal marker.

pages.title: Town management
pages.text: Rename your own town through native management. Deletion checks ownership, unpaid obligations and resident state; treasury refunds follow canonical rules. Depositing/withdrawing treasury funds does not change ownership.
